description: Right to be forgotten; irreversible. Pass exactly one of session_id or learner_id. With session_id: erases this learner's durable state for this lesson AND the cross-lesson profile and review schedule. With learner_id (no live session needed): every lesson's progress too, and the learner's live sessions close. Returns {forgotten, scope: lesson|learner, erased: [{kind, lessons?}], kept: [{kind, lessons?, path?}], display_markdown}: kept names what stays on disk (the library's lessons and their sources); show display_markdown to the learner. language (fr|en), optional, is the language of display_markdown; by default the lesson's with session_id, else the learner's last lesson's, else the server's. To merely close, use end_session. This server plays one learner: to erase all of that learner's data, pass neither session_id nor learner_id; a learner_id that is not that learner is refused and nothing is erased.
name: forget_session
